reels.title: Seen by 14, paid by 0
reels.caption: Kitty ka paisa: seen by 14. Nayi saree: 40 replies. Har group ki treasurer ko bhejo!
reels.idea: Shruti asks the group for kitty money and gets Seen by 14, zero replies; Tina posts a new saree and the chat explodes; Shruti trades the saree link for payments.
reels.beats: hook: seen by 14, paid 0 / esc: Tina posts saree, 40 replies, Shruti fumes / twist: link only for payers, payments pour in, even Tina pays / button: 14/14, and Shruti never had the link

experiment.hook: Shruti glaring at her phone with the banner "14 ne dekha, 0 ne bheja" and the PAID 0/14 chip
experiment.variable: story told mostly on a WhatsApp group screen instead of a living-room scene
experiment.hypothesis: a chat every kitty admin knows gets more shares and saves than the sitcom baseline: skip rate under 60% and at least 3 shares

script.line: Kitty ka paisa! Aaj last date!
Paise pe seen... saree pe chaalis reply?!
Saree ka link... sirf paisa bhejne walon ko!
Darling, link toh mere paas hai!
Seen by chaudah. Paid by chaudah.

review.notes: Every kitty treasurer lives the Seen by 14 moment; the PAID counter chip keeps the stake visible on mute; the swap (link for money) is a see-it reveal on the chat; button flips the opening and Shruti outsmarts them with a link she does not even have. Rewrote once: first ending (Tina pays for her own saree link) needed reasoning, so Tina now just gets told to pay too.

reels.title: Pink nahi toh entry nahi!
reels.format: Door arrivals, dress-code judge at the front door
reels.caption: Dress code wali admin, apna hi message bhool gayi. Tag your Tanya!
reels.idea: Tanya stands at her own front door scoring every guest zero for not wearing pink; all of them came in yellow, because Tanya's own group message said YELLOW.
reels.beats: hook: pink or no entry / esc: Shruti 0, Avika -2, Myra -10 / twist: Tanya's own message says YELLOW / button: guests score Tanya zero

experiment.hook: doorbell, Tanya in pink blocks the doorway with a scoreboard and shouts 'Pink nahi, toh entry nahi!' at Shruti standing there in yellow
experiment.variable: story told as a string of front-door entries (one guest per doorbell, a score chip each) instead of a living-room scene
experiment.hypothesis: a doorbell plus a new face every 4 s holds viewers through the middle: watched % above 30 and skip rate under 55%, with at least 3 shares from organisers tagging friends

script.line: Ruko! Pink nahi, toh entry nahi!
Group pe dekho, sab likha hai!

review.notes: Every group has a dress-code admin; Tanya's catchphrase 'Group pe dekho, sab likha hai' sets up her own downfall, so the twist is a see-it phone screen, not a fact to work out. Pink host vs yellow guests reads on mute from frame one. Myra claims first ('Sabse zyada yellow!') before the drop. Button reuses 'Pink? Zero!' with the scoreboard flipped onto Tanya. Rewrote once: first draft had Tanya rating outfits 1 to 10 (idea as banked) but the scores alone had no reveal; second ending (Tanya's tag still on her saree) was weaker than the group message callback.

ideas.idea: Hook: group chat, Tanya: "Is mahine ka kitty paisa sab bhej do" and it shows Seen by 14, zero replies. Context: a minute later Tina posts a photo of her new saree and the chat explodes with 40 "kahan se li?" replies. Ending: Tanya types "Jo paisa bhejegi, usko bataungi" and UPI payment notifications pour down the screen.
ideas.format: Phone screen group chat + Tanya reaction close-ups, end line: send this to your kitty group
ideas.source: Trend: Invite-your-group question (our reel, 65 shares, https://www.instagram.com/reel/De2Kz2IP-cB/) + Housie money fight (19 likes, 8 comments)

ideas.idea: Hook: Shruti bursts in: "Bhatiji ki shaadi 21 ko hai, sangeet pe poori kitty nachegi!" Context: the kitty becomes dance rehearsal to a loud retro song, Tanya counts the steps and Ruhi turns left every time everyone turns right. Ending: the sangeet stage photo, the whole gang in matching lehengas, Ruhi the only one facing the other way.
ideas.format: Living-room rehearsal, group lip-sync beat, stage photo freeze at the end
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi season kitty (weddings from 20-21 Nov, https://happyfares.in/blog/wedding-season-flights-november-2026-muhurat/) + Group lip-sync throwback (~10.5M clip views)

ideas.idea: Ek haath wali packing: pairs stand side by side, each may use only one hand (other hand behind the back), and together they wrap a mithai box in newspaper, tape it and tie a ribbon bow in 1 minute. Twist: halfway the host shouts "Badlo!" and every lady moves to a new partner and finishes someone else's half-wrapped box. Neatest box wins.
ideas.format: Carousel: rules, props (boxes, newspaper, tape, ribbon), the swap twist, ugliest-box last slide
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali 8 Nov (13 days away) + Looks easy, isn't (298 likes, 25 comments)

ideas.idea: Saree pleat race: each lady gets a dupatta or old saree and a safety pin and must make 7 even pleats and pin them in 1 minute. Twist: everyone wears socks on both hands. Best pleats win, judged by the host holding them up.
ideas.format: Carousel: rules, socks-on-hands photo, pleat results lined up, comment your score
ideas.source: Trend: Shaadi season kitty (weddings from 20-21 Nov) + One-minute game (Roop ki rani, 646 likes, 18 comments)

ideas.idea: Purse ke andar kya hai: the host calls an item and the first lady to pull it from her own purse gets a point (safety pin, toffee, old bill, hair clip, a Rs 1 coin). ideas.format: Carousel: rules, item list slide, funniest finds slide, comment what is in your purse

ideas.source: Trend: New Tambola format (89 likes, 20 comments, https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeybVBCAgR_/) + Looks easy, isn't

ideas.idea: Kaju katli tower: in 1 minute, stack kaju katli pieces (or cardboard diamonds) into the tallest tower using one hand. Twist: your other hand must hold a full cup of chai without spilling; a spill means start over.
ideas.format: Kitty Game Ideas carousel (8-20 ladies, 10 min: mithai or card diamonds, plates, cups, timer)
ideas.source: Trend: Looks easy, isn't (298 likes, 25 comments) + Festival window: Diwali week

ideas.idea: Dhanteras kitty draw: Tanya shakes the chits bowl, "Iss baar kitty kiski niklegi?" and every lady is already shopping gold in her head (thought bubbles: jhumka, kangan, sikka). Ruhi wins and screams. End: Shruti opens her hisaab diary, "Teen mahine ka contribution pending hai, Ruhi ji", and Ruhi hands the whole envelope straight back.
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week (Dhanteras 6 Nov) + money hisaab; our top post 1842 comments

ideas.idea: Diwali gift exchange at kitty: everyone puts a wrapped mithai box in the middle and picks one. Myra opens a soan papdi box and freezes. End: under the wrapper is a sticker "With love, Myra", the same box she gave last year, now back home. Caption asks: "Tumhare group mein soan papdi kaun ghumaata hai?"
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week (8 Nov) + Comment-to-join CTA

ideas.idea: Diwali potluck group chat: phone screen, host posts "Kal kitty potluck, sab kuch laana"; every reply is "Main kuch sweet le aaungi". Next day the doorbell rings again and again. End: the table has six boxes of kaju katli and not one namkeen, Tina walks in with a seventh.
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week + potluck

ideas.idea: Diya on a spoon relay: teams pass an LED tealight diya on a steel spoon held in the mouth, no hands, down the line. Twist: the last lady must say a full Diwali wish to the host before she can drop it in the thali. 2 teams, 10 minutes.
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week + Looks easy, isn't (DezNr1TO2xh, 298 likes)

ideas.idea: Andhi rangoli: in pairs, one lady is blindfolded and pours coloured rice or salt into a chalk diya outline on a thali, guided only by her partner's voice. 1 minute per pair. Twist: the guide must stand behind her, so left and right are flipped. Group votes the best diya.
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week + 1-minute rangoli (Diwali party game lists)

ideas.idea: Angrezi gaana: the host reads Bollywood song lines translated word for word into English ("Your face is a moon"). First lady to sing the original line wins a point; paper and pen to keep score. Twist: you must sing it, saying it does not count.
ideas.source: Trend: Hindi + English word puzzle (DewmgLDzEkC, 24 comments on 5 likes)

ideas.idea: Diwali safai wali Housie: every called number is a chore ("Number 7: pankha saaf!"); whoever cuts it does it. End: the host sips chai while the gang has cleaned her whole house.
ideas.source: Trend: safai wali housie (this week) + Diwali

research.source: Our reel "Kya aapka Kitty Group hai Kitty Party App pr? Nahi, toh abhi invite karo sabko" (5605 views, 65 shares, 22 saves, skip 39%)
research.learn: A question about the viewer's own kitty group gets forwarded to that group; end reels with a line people send to their gang.

research.source: "POV: Your kitty party just got a whole lot more creative! Our first-ever Kitty Party Soap Making Workshop"
research.learn: Kitties are booking hands-on activities (soap, candles, crafts); a make-and-show activity with a messy result is a ready game and reel scene.

research.source: technosports: India reel audios Oct 2-9 (Gangnam Style ~10.5M clip views, group lip-sync and dance)
research.learn: A loud throwback song done by a whole group in sync is the top reel audio pattern; a gang dance beat fits entrances and endings.

research.source: November Holidays 2026 (Diwali 8 Nov, Bhai Dooj 10/11 Nov, Chhath 13-16 Nov)
research.learn: After Diwali the kitty calendar fills with Bhai Dooj and Chhath; post Diwali ideas by 5 Nov and plan the post-Diwali leftover mithai and diet talk.

research.source: "Wedding Season Flights 2026: What Opens on 20 November" (Dev Uthani Ekadashi 20-21 Nov, busiest muhurat to mid-Dec)
research.learn: Weddings restart 20-21 Nov; kitties turn into sangeet rehearsals, outfit borrowing and who-is-invited talk, all real scenes for late November.

research.source: "Flower Thumb Impression Game | Fun Kitty Party Game Idea" (roll the dice, make flowers with thumb prints)
research.learn: A dice roll deciding what you draw or fill turns a craft into a race; finished sheets make a colourful last slide.

research.source: "Karwachauth kitty" #karwachauthspecial #ladieskitty (plus "The Queens Are Here" Karwa kitty, 18 likes, 12 comments)
research.learn: Karwa Chauth (29 Oct) kitties are posting now in red sarees and mehendi; the husband-gift talk the day after is the real follow-up scene.

research.source: "CASINO NIGHT, A KITTY PARTY! Who said kitty parties have to be the same old games"
research.learn: Casino with chips and cards is a fresh theme next to Sona Chandi; betting with tokens works as a game mechanic.

research.source: "BengaliKittytheme yehDiya #tambola"
research.learn: State themes (Bengali laal paad, Punjabi, South Indian) give instant costumes and one funny borrowed line everyone overuses.

research.source: technosports: India reel audios Oct 2-9 (Koi Kaise Mohabbat Chhupaye ~5.9M clip views, Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani ~4.2M)
research.learn: Old Bollywood songs lead Indian lip-sync reels this month; a retro line sung by the gang fits any theme or entrance beat.

research.source: "Log zameen-jaydaad ke liye ladte hain... aur hum yahan housie ke paison ke liye lad rahe hain!" #kittyparty #relatable
research.learn: Fighting over the Housie prize hisaab is a real, relatable kitty moment; high comment share because everyone has seen it.

research.source: "Apna Sapna Money Money - new kitty game... new Tambola game introduced"
research.learn: A new rule on top of familiar Housie gets saves and comments; keep the ticket, change how numbers are called.

research.source: "SONA CHANDI - GOLD & SILVER CARD PARTY... QUEEN ENERGY"
research.learn: Gold and silver dress code is this year's pre-Diwali kitty theme; shiny outfits plus cards read festive in one frame.

research.source: Kullu Dussehra Tambola (866 likes); Lahaul man wins a Royal Enfield on a Rs 1500 ticket
research.learn: The big-win moment (last number, the scream) is the most liked fresh Tambola post; build reels and covers around the final number.

research.source: Curly Tales: 6 Games To Elevate Your Diwali Party Nights (Teen Patti, Tambola, charades, blindfolded sweet tasting)
research.learn: Diwali party game lists push sweet-guessing and festive charades; mithai is the obvious Diwali prop for game carousels.

research.source: Our reel: "Comment or DM me. Chalo sabko batate hai Kitty Party Stories"
research.learn: Our best post ever (110k views, 1695 shares, 547 saves) asked viewers to comment to get something; end reels with a question the gang would answer in comments.

research.source: "Ye challenge dekhkar lag raha hai EASY... lekin WINNER banna itna aasaan nahi! 1 Minute Game"
research.learn: Frame the game as easy-looking, then show everyone failing; the dare to try it drives comments and tags.

research.source: "Kitty Party Paper Game! A unique English + Hindi word puzzle that challenges your brain"
research.learn: Puzzle games get far more comments than likes: viewers type their answers. A guessable puzzle on screen = free comments.

research.source: The Nod, Mar 2026: kitty party ladies, Instagram and "cringe" content (Matka Latka skits, Bridgerton kitties)
research.learn: Elaborately staged, costumed kitty skits are a watched mini-genre in 2026; dressed sets and costumes are the draw, matching our team feedback.

research.source: Dussehra and Diwali 2026 dates: Karwa Chauth 29 Oct, Dhanteras 6 Nov, Diwali 8 Nov, Bhai Dooj 11 Nov, Chhath 13-16 Nov
research.learn: Diwali kitties (card parties, gift exchange, potluck mithai) peak 1-3 weeks before 8 Nov; Karwa Chauth ideas must post by 28 Oct.
